messages:
marta: heads-up  i'm carving out a tiny 'embed caching + provisioning' note for Dedicated docs. aim: one page with a) how prefix/KV caching affects reserved pools, b) quick CLI/TF/Node snippets, c) an SLA callout when decorators change routing.

eli: important  call out that cache warming differs between shared and reserved pools. reserved pools with prewarmed KV can hit much lower p95. add a sentence and a sample warmup command.

marta: adding warmup example: `rwdctl cache warm --tenant T-88 --model redwood-dedicated/embedding-v1 --prefix "onboard-"` and note: warmups can increase short-term token bill.

nate: for TF migration, customers hit enum mismatch and also lose cache-presets when they migrate. include a small terraform hint that preserves cache presets on pool recreate.

marta: terraform hint (pseudo):
```hcl
# preserve cache presets by exporting and re-importing
data "rwd_cache_preset" "old" { tenant_id = var.tenant }
resource "rwd_dedicated_pool" "p" { tenant_id = var.tenant autoscale { policy = "balanced" } }
resource "rwd_cache_preset" "reapply" { tenant_id = var.tenant presets = data.rwd_cache_preset.old.presets }
```

eli: add a short CLI dry-run and commit for provisioning reserved pool (so people preview cache/preset application):
```bash
rwdctl reserved create --tenant T-88 --gpu a100 --region us-west-2 --dry-run --apply-cache-presets
rwdctl reserved create --tenant T-88 --gpu a100 --region us-west-2 --commit --apply-cache-presets
```

nate: include a Node snippet showing how to request a dedicated embedding variant and prefer cached prefixes at request time. tiny 4-line example.

marta: node snippet added:
```js
// prefer dedicated embedding with cached prefix
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.RWD_KEY });
const r = await client.embed({ model: 'redwood-dedicated/embedding-v1', input: 'doc text', cachePrefix: 'onboard-' });
```

eli: SLA callout: if a decorator routes traffic to reserved pools the effective latency SLO may change and cache warmup patterns will differ. suggest a line: "Enabling reserved routing may improve p95 after warmup but can change billing and SLOs; coordinate with CSM."

marta: adding final checklist bullets: 1) validate tenant labels, 2) preview with `--dry-run`, 3) export/import cache presets before pool replace, 4) notify CSM for SLA delta.

doc-bot: PR opened by marta: https://git.redwood.internal/r/redwood/docs/+/7102 :eyes:

eli: i'll review cache-preserve TF snippet formatting. prioritize the CLI dry-run wording.

marta: thanks  will merge after editorial pass and lint. will ping here when live. :shipit:
